authored_outputs: Fresh worker-authored analysis and validation files at the review root; frozen subdirectory contains unchanged user-provided submitted texts/JSON.
source_policy: Full third-party bodies, extracted text and page images are local ignored data only under sources/raw; no such artifact is included in AUTHORED_OUTPUT_MANIFEST.json.
primary_source_inventory: SOURCES_RETRIEVAL.json records public raw PDF byte identities, URLs, headers and retrieval times. Text/image hashes are not distributed.
locators: INDEPENDENT_PRIMARY_COMPARISON.md gives printed/PDF pages and section/figure/definition locators.
order_evidence: PRECOMPARISON_CHECKPOINT.json fixes the comparison before prior submitted audit bodies were read; comparison bytes remain unchanged.
snapshot_binding: Nine frozen submitted members match frozen/SUBMITTED_PINS.json at the supplied original head identifier. This worker did not query remote Git objects.
verification_scope: Self-contained universal derivation plus finite checks; not human peer review or proof assistant certification.
independence: No external outreach or other-worker consultation. No subagents spawned.
prior_edition_policy: Historical submitted metadata is retained byte-for-byte and faithfully distinguished from newly verified facts.
